```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 SWE‑Lancer

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)'
        required: true
      agent:
        description: 'Agent name'
        required: true
      provider:
        description: 'Provider name'
        required: true
      model:
        description: 'Model name'
        required: true
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Maximum runtime in seconds (default 3600)'
        required: false
        default: '3600'
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'Wait time after setup in seconds (default 900)'
        required: false
        default: '900'

concurrency:
  group: benchmark-v2-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  run-benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      # Add any other secrets required by the benchmark here
      # e.g., API_KEY: ${{ secrets.API_KEY }}
    steps:
      - name: Disk cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up disk space..."
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /usr/local/share/dotnet
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
          df -h
        shell: bash

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
          lfs: true

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches
        shell: bash

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
        shell: bash

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install
        shell: bash

      - name: Pull SWE‑Lancer monolith image
        run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1
        shell: bash

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise ${{ inputs.exercise }} \
            --agent ${{ inputs.agent }} \
            --provider ${{ inputs.provider }} \
            --model ${{ inputs.model }} \
            --timeout_seconds ${{ inputs.timeout_seconds }} \
            --v2_setup_wait_seconds ${{ inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload benchmark results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
          if-no-files-found: error
```
